g.text: ESP8266 Wemos D1 Mini + MPU6050 | 3.3 V logic | Rev A | 12 Nov 2026
Fit R4/R5 only if module has no I2C pull-ups.
D7 (GPIO13) -> R3 -> Anode; cathode to GND.
D5 (GPIO14) PWM -> R1 (220 ohm) -> BZ1 (+); (-) to GND.
Direct passive piezo (<=12 mA); no transistor driver.
NOTES: Module symbols show functional pins; verify the purchased board pinout and 3.3 V compatibility.
No battery circuit on this sheet. Footprints are intentionally unassigned; review before PCB layout.
